import json,re,html
d=json.load(open('products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/current-request/candidate-683136.json'))
def find(o):
  if isinstance(o,dict):
    if 'post_stream' in o: return o
    for v in o.values():
      r=find(v)
      if r: return r
  return None
t=find(d) or d
posts=t.get('post_stream',{}).get('posts',[])
print('keys',list(d.keys())[:10],'posts',len(posts),'stream',len(t.get('post_stream',{}).get('stream',[])))
users=set()
for p in posts:
  users.add(p.get('username'))
  txt=re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',html.unescape(p.get('cooked','')))
  txt=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',txt)
  txt=re.sub(r'@\w+','@user',txt)
  print('---',p.get('post_number'),p.get('created_at'),'op' if p.get('username')==posts[0].get('username') else 'other')
  print(txt[:420])
print('distinct_users',len(users))
